limit.description: The workspace's cap, read from the service's /v1/limits. Null either when that read failed (limitKnown false) or when no cap of this kind applies (limitKnown true).

limitKnown.description: False when the limits read failed, so the limit is unknown.

releases.description: Releases held, summed over the Builds the caller can see, against maxTotalReleases. Outside the enterprise plan a member sees only their own Builds while the cap counts every member's, so used can read low.

truncated.description: Present and true when more Builds are visible than the command reads releases for, so used counts only some of them.

activeDeployments.description: The workspace's undeleted deployments in any status but failed, stopped and stop_failed, against maxActiveDeployments.

builds.description: Builds the caller can see, against maxBuilds; can read low the same way releases does.

note.description: Says which counts cover only the Builds the caller can see.
